viewerQuestion: Will a new GPU make every game faster by the same amount?
viewerTakeaway: More frames added is not the same as a bigger upgrade; a game's starting point and how much it leans on the GPU both matter.

requiredCapabilities.description: Existing deterministic static Compare UI capture.

beats.narration: More frames doesn't mean a bigger upgrade.
In SpecSmith's model estimates, an RTX 4060 to RTX 5070 upgrade, same Ryzen 5 7600 at 1440p High, takes Valorant from 263 to 305 FPS.
Alan Wake 2 only goes from 43 to 65.
Fewer frames added, but from 43, that is the bigger jump. Valorant was already far above it.
SpecSmith's model gives Alan Wake 2 far more GPU weight than Valorant.
beats.onScreenText: The GPU matters more in some games

beats.narration: Judge an upgrade by the games you play.
